headline: ServiceNow links AI-driven efficiency to declining workforce; says smaller teams are delivering more
summary: ServiceNow reported that internal AI adoption generated over $1 billion in annualized efficiency gains, allowing it to slow recruitment in support functions while continuing to expand revenue-generating teams. Leadership framed the company's slightly lower overall headcount as a positive outcome of enhanced productivity rather than a broad layoff strategy. As a provider of enterprise automation tools, ServiceNow's operational model serves as a real-world example of how AI is beginning to reshape organizational workforce planning and hiring needs.

headline: Walmart investigates alleged Rs 150 crore kickbacks involving Flipkart employees
summary: Walmart has launched an investigation into alleged kickbacks amounting to Rs 150 crore involving employees at its e-commerce subsidiary, Flipkart. The inquiry centers on potential financial irregularities and misconduct within the company's internal processes.

headline: Diageo gets Khushboo Gupta as global senior TA partner
summary: Beverage giant Diageo has appointed Khushboo Gupta as its new Global Senior Talent Acquisition Partner. In this role, she will be responsible for driving strategic hiring and talent management initiatives on a global scale for the company.

headline: Rising Star: Hevin Verghese C on why HR earns credibility by measuring what it changes
summary: In a profile on emerging professional leadership, Hevin Verghese C highlights how Human Resources can establish organizational authority by focusing on impact. He argues that HR builds true credibility by measuring specific outcomes and business changes rather than just tracking routine activities. This approach underscores the shift toward a more strategic, data-driven HR function.

headline: Festive cheer: Diwali bonuses and pay hikes across India
summary: Indian companies are rolling out Diwali bonuses and salary increments to boost employee morale during the festive season. This nationwide trend highlights positive economic sentiment and increased workforce spending power across various sectors. The widespread pay hikes reflect organizations' efforts to reward employees and retain talent during the major holiday.

headline: The unwritten rules of the workplace
summary: HR leaders highlight essential workplace lessons rarely covered in formal handbooks or standard performance reviews. They emphasize that strong individual performance does not automatically signal readiness for leadership, and true career growth stems from taking on expanded responsibilities rather than simple title changes.

headline: Cognizant reshapes workforce strategy with Project Leap
summary: Cognizant has lowered its Project Leap restructuring cost estimate to $180–250 million while continuing to expand its total headcount to nearly 360,000 and lower voluntary attrition. The IT services firm reported $5.7 billion in Q3 revenue with over half of its code now AI-assisted, though falling bookings prompted a reduction in full-year revenue guidance. The move highlights a dual strategy of cost realignment and workforce preparation for an AI-driven future.

headline: Kerala approves MLA pay hike amid fiscal strain
summary: The Kerala cabinet has approved a 40 percent salary hike for Members of the Legislative Assembly, raising monthly pay from Rs 70,000 to Rs 98,000 for the first time in eight years. While lawmakers argue the increase is necessary to cover rising office and transportation expenses, the decision has drawn criticism due to the state's ongoing fiscal strain. Even with this revision, Kerala's legislative compensation remains among the lowest in India compared to states like Odisha and Telangana.

headline: Dropbox to cut 9% of workforce as CTO Ali Dasdan prepares to exit
summary: Dropbox plans to reduce its global workforce by approximately 9% to realign spending with its product development and strategic growth priorities. The restructuring, estimated to cost between $27 million and $33 million, coincides with the upcoming departure of Chief Technology Officer Ali Dasdan in mid-November. Despite the job cuts, the company expects its third-quarter financial performance to meet or exceed its previous guidance.

headline: Centre hikes by 3% for employees and pensioners
summary: The Union Cabinet has approved a 3 percentage point increase in Dearness Allowance (DA) and Dearness Relief (DR), raising the rate from 60% to 63% of basic pay for central government employees and pensioners. Effective retrospectively from July 1, 2026, the bi-annual inflation adjustment will benefit nearly 11.6 million individuals ahead of Diwali. Based on the Consumer Price Index for Industrial Workers, this latest hike marks a cumulative 17 percentage point rise in allowances since July 2023.

headline: Krisumi Corporation appoints Tomy Thomas as CHRO
summary: Krisumi Corporation has appointed Tomy Thomas as its Chief Human Resources Officer, effective October 2026. Thomas brings over 30 years of HR leadership experience back to the company, where he previously served as President of HR from 2021 to 2025. His extensive background spans the real estate and hospitality sectors, with past roles at firms such as Emaar MGF and Grand Hyatt Delhi.
